title: WF03 Stage11 testfix2 rework1: SIM isolation failures resolved via per-test transient-data cleanup and default seed restoration
summary: Resolved cross-test contamination that previously produced aggregate integration cascades (44 failures including TC-SIM-01-01). TestHarness now resets only transient tables and restores required default OIDC seed rows where needed. Focused OIDC-09 seed verification now passes, and TC-SIM-01-01 is no longer reported in integration failures.

root_cause.details: Integration tests used pooled DB connections outside TestHarness rollback scope, leaving persistent fixture rows between tests. A prior broad cleanup removed seeded default rows (tenant bpm-default binding and jit_provisioning_config seed), which then caused OIDC seed assertions to fail because migrations were already marked as applied.

changes: Added transient-table cleanup in tests/integration/helpers.zig (resetTestData) for per-test isolation without truncating configuration tables.
Added ensureDefaultOidcSeeds in tests/integration/helpers.zig to guarantee default tenant realm binding and jit_provisioning_config seed row presence.
Restored default seed rows in bpm_test database via idempotent SQL upserts and revalidated OIDC-09 integration suite.

commands.evidence: test_wf03_oidc09_rework1.txt reports EXIT=0 after seed restoration.
No TC-SIM-01-01 or OIDC09/OIDC12 seed failures are present; remaining blocker is OIDC31 env prerequisite (BPM_IDP_BASE_URL/BPM_TEST_URL).

prevention: Do not rely on transaction rollback alone for tests that use pooled connections outside harness-owned transactions.
Limit automatic cleanup to transient data tables; avoid truncating configuration/seed tables used by migration-backed assertions.
If seeded rows are accidentally removed after migrations have already been marked applied, restore them with explicit idempotent upserts.
